reserveReview.rationale: Fresh pinned reads at finalized Ethereum block 26285088 (hash 0xcc8cd23cedcdd85f2bd114cc1057297acbdbdb7776785585465fec8904420534, timestamp 2026-10-27T15:57:11Z): asset() is USDD 0x4f8e5de400de08b164e7421b3ee387f461becd1a, totalAssets() is 208,243,060.345524678557757452 USDD, sUSDD totalSupply() is 194,518,337.928076471752346061 shares and the vault holds zero idle USDD. The exact verified SavingsUsdd code explains the zero balance: _mint transfers USDD, calls UsddJoin.join and Pot.join, then increases share supply; _burn decreases share supply and calls Pot.exit and UsddJoin.exit. totalAssets() is converted share accounting, not a measurement of external strategy assets. The position is therefore the high-risk USDD savings/Pot claim linked to the parent, not independently measured Smart Allocator venue positions; the single slice stays 100% because idle is observed zero. Issuer terms describe anytime USDD withdrawal with no lock-up. Parent reserve, peg and governance risks remain inherited; no venue allocation, financial assurance or legal safeguard is inferred.
